# Rig grade swarm master handoff

The operator asked for this handoff so a fresh session continues as master. The quota on this account's week is nearly spent.

## State at handoff
- The ledger holds 36 tasks. 34 are merged into dev, with every PR merged and none left open.
- Second wave (from the OpenRig video re-read, plan in the operator's plans folder "ok-plan-them-and-dreamy-liskov"):
  - Done: g1 health verdicts, g2 task work folders, g3 swarm templates, g4 snapshot and restore, g5 trace locators, g6 trace sweep cleanup crew, g8 typed seat links.
  - In progress: g7 learned note maturity plus swarm culture file is in pr state, waiting on checks, with engineer 36.
  - Still open: g9 autonomy level. It depends on g3, which is done, and the swarm claims it as soon as no claimed task shares its territory.
- Phases:
  - p1 messaging: done.
  - p2 seats: open until g7 merges.
  - p3 intent: open until g9 merges.
  - p4 work beyond code: open; only the troubleshooting pilot swarm is left, and it waits on the operator.
  - p5 health: open. Its tasks are merged, so close it after checking the last follow-ups below.
  - p6 doctrine: open; five manifesto proposal questions on the ledger are still unanswered.
  - p7 carried over: done.

## Promised to the operator
- After each merge that changes a ledger page, check the live page at http://127.0.0.1:8765/rig-grade-swarm with playwright-cmd, report what you saw, then close the browser.
- Still unchecked: the "Give verdict" button. It only renders next to a finding, so check it the next time one appears.
- g7: confirm the culture text shows up in the priming of a newly spawned engineer.
- g9: confirm the swarm panel shows the autonomy level.
- Give every new health finding a verdict with `agentihooks swarm rig-grade-swarm verdict <id> <kind> --note ...`.

## Waiting on operator decisions (do not build without a yes)
- Five manifesto proposals: open questions d1-p1 to d1-p5.
- Troubleshooting pilot swarm: it would add sessions beyond this swarm's.
- Bundle PR 114 and the ci lane prompt follow-up.
- Herdr hybrid follow-up: make snapshot and restore use herdr's agent resume reporting, and reach agents on other machines through herdr. Herdr has no message store, so the inbox stays the store and herdr is the transport.
- Master over-monitoring follow-up: the master trips that check by design. Give it its own threshold or exempt it.
- Other open follow-ups to triage:
  - The ledger server only reloads when its own folder changes, so merged inbox and routing changes need a server restart.
  - A conditions process-group test failed once in CI (a race) and passed on rerun.
  - The operator-intent brain entry still carries the qitp refactor into agentihooks sessions. The brain regenerates it, so the fix belongs in the brain or kernel.
  - The qitp crew's ledger reminder text lives in their repo, and cross-repo work needs operator instruction.

## Operator preferences seen this session
- Plain words on the ledger, with no ids. The operator likes short ELI10 summaries when asked.
- Operator writes on the ledger must reach agents with no tool call needed, once per agent. That is built (n1); keep it working.
- The operator wants agents told to merge PRs immediately, never left open.
- swarm-buildout has its own master (swarm-buildout-master-2) and is paused for the operator's fixes. Do not touch it.
